description.narrative: Grupo Salud Auna Mexico S.A. de C.V. and Auna S.A. (Auna or the Group), an integrated healthcare group providing medical services and specialized healthcare insurance plans, has requested IFC to support Aunas expansion and reprofiling of the Groups debt associated with operations in Mexico, Peru, and Colombia. Founded in 1989, Auna has built one of the largest integrated healthcare platforms consisting of a network of healthcare services facilities and a portfolio of oncology, dental, vision and general health plans. Aunas network included 31 healthcare facilities with a total of 2,323 beds across Mexico, Peru and Colombia and 1.4 million health plan members in Peru.

The most significant, expected project level outcomes are increased access to care in Mexico, Peru, and Colombia. At the market level, the most significant expected market-level outcomes sustaining the development of Mexicos private healthcare services market. By expanding its value-based care model that combines hospitals, clinics, diagnostics, and insurance, the Company is expected to deepen the adoption of value healthcare models by competitors and result in better integrated care, especially oncology care.
